sn42.7:2.6: In the context of renunciate life, _brahmacariya_ often implies “celibacy”, the explanation being that Brahmā, as a being created by the practice of absorption, is beyond sensual desires. In the Brahmanicxal system, it referred to the period of study of a young man under a teacher before marriage. Here, however, we see that it is used of layfolk in a more general sense of “spiritual practice” or “divine conduct”.
